module: Retained PolyfaceMesh coordinate, face and SEQEND records
coverage: 60 principal cases per configuration: 12 pinned unchanged ezdxf producer inputs across six DXF profiles and both transports, with wire/edit, layer/removal, clone and invalid-save checks; plus 12 native carrier cases.

Full retained child packets are compared by raw typed tag values before and after a coordinate ordinal edit and signed face-index edit. All unrelated child tags and physical record order remain exact.

Coordinate and face projections bind actual records/models; producer block-record owner form and native direct POLYLINE owner form survive. Native point/line/quad faces and advisory source counts are retained.

Current face-layer identity releases the old layer guard. Null layer inheritance and explicit color survive detach/readoption and save/reload. Foreign adoption rejects; same-document readoption retains exact child identities.

Plain same-document clones have fresh child identities and independent geometry. Decorated graphs with private/owned/external dependencies reject cloning. Invalid active signed index, nonfinite coordinate and changed profile reject before bytes/seed mutation.

12 normal cases per configuration cover authored and retained meshes, NaN/infinity/zero inputs and both transports. Save, clone and adoption all reject, without output or handle allocation; failed adoption leaves the parent detached.
48 output DXFs per configuration audited with ezdxf1.4.4; zero errors/repairs. No native CAD application runtime was available or claimed.
fixture_scope: Native carriers retain all eleven source POLYFACE packets except the explicitly mapped parent common owner. Carrier layer-table records are synthetic; they are not original layer-table qualification. Producer fixtures are unchanged ezdxf1.4.4 output. Source/fixture hashes are verified by the harness.
findings_fixed: RemoveEntityFromDocument unconditionally dereferenced nullable Face.Layer; fixed before7f6530d and covered by loaded detach/readoption.

The inherited Normal setter permits nonfinite stored state. Before133747c, all12 normal controls saved, cloned and adopted successfully, and every saved output failed reload. Shared Polyface-specific normal validation now protects save/clone/adoption for both authored and retained meshes.
